name: Disclosure Request Identification 1
definition: Information identifying the disclosure request for shareholders identification published by the issuer or third party nominated by the issuer in order to receive the disclosure responses from intermediaries in the custody chain.

IssuerDisclosureRequestIdentification.name: Issuer Disclosure Request Identification
IssuerDisclosureRequestIdentification.definition: Official and unique reference assigned to a shareholders identification disclosure request process by the issuer or third party nominated by him.

ShareholdersDisclosureRecordDate.name: Shareholders Disclosure Record Date
ShareholdersDisclosureRecordDate.definition: Date set by the issuer on which shareholders identity is determined based on the settled positions struck in the books of the Issuer CSD or any other first intermediary at the close of business day.
